_comment: The unit spellings the ingredient line parser is expected to recognise,
and the units.code each must resolve to. This is a contract with two
sides, like test/fixtures/normalization.json: the Dart parser tests build
their UnitCatalog from this file, and tool/gen_unit_alias_sql.dart turns
it into supabase/tests/unit_alias_test.sql, which asserts the database
agrees. Add a spelling here and `make test-sql` tells you whether the
migration that seeds unit_names actually has it.
Keys are written as a human writes them; both sides normalize before
head: head
